recent.text: Final: Rockets 116, Cliopers 104 Durant 32 pts, 9 rebs, 4 assts Sengun 20 pts, 8 rebs, 7 assts Thompson 20 pts (9-12 FG) KD goes for 22 points in the 2nd half. Hit some huge shots down the stretch. Rockets improve to 13-5.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Durant just splashed 3 3-pointers in a row. He's got a season-high 32 points.
recent.author: Will Guillory
recent.quoted_text: Beautiful play design out of the timeout for Houston leads to a wide open 3 in the corner for Kevin Durant. He's got 26 points and 8 rebounds.

recent.text: Season high 32 points for Kevin Durant. His second 30-point game of the season. Durant is 11/19 and 4/6 from three.

recent.text: Really strong response from the Rockets after briefly losing the lead early in the 3rd. From that point, they've outscored the Clips, 30-15. KD and Tari Eason combined for 18 of those 30 points. Feelsl ike Rockets are finally starting to impose their will.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: Tari Eason hits a floater as the buzzer sounds and the #Rockets end the third quarter up 85-75 over the Clippers. Houston was down 5 early in the frame before a 10-0 run pushed it back in front. KD and Garland have 20p each. Şengün and Thompson with 16p apiece.
recent.author: Varun Shankar

recent.text: Mentioned that the guards needed to be more active after a slow start. FVV just forced back-to-back turnovers. Amen Thompson has 7 pts and 2 assts in the quarter. The Rockets are starting to pick their energy up as this game goes.
recent.author: Will Guillory

recent.text: The Clippers started making shots and briefly took a lead, but the Rockets immediately responded with a 10-0 run. Amen Thompson is up to 16 points on 7-9 shooting. Would like to see him get more opportunities to attack with the ball in his hands.
